summary: Full-width dark hero in the style of large CX groups: a photo under a strong brand-colour shade (or a plain dark ground), the headline, lead and buttons on the left, and on the right a column of two solid cards that slide in one after the other. The first card lists 2-3 recent items (meta line and title, each a link, for example a case study, a report or a new delivery center); the second features one item with a small photo, a line of text and a button. Every item and the feature must be real and come from the brief (published case studies, reports, announcements, certifications); never invent news. Suits enterprise BPOs that have case studies, reports or announcements to point to; without them use hero-fullbleed.
